ch.note: Swiss Federal Office of Energy consumer mix direct emissions 89.4 g CO2e/kWh. Sensitivity bounds allow imports and seasonality. Proxy for case year.

de.note: 2023 JRC generated/net-imported electricity value 103.8 g/MJ × 3.6 / 1000. Analyst sensitivity bounds.

ie.note: 2023 JRC value 85.6 g/MJ × 3.6 / 1000. Analyst sensitivity bounds.

eu.note: Rounded EU mixed-geography proxy informed by national variation, with scenario bounds.

unknown.note: Broad analyst proxy for unresolved hosting geography.

pue.note: Analyst data center scenarios using Cloud Carbon Footprint PUE methodology. Applied to IT-side factors only.

vcpu-hour.note: Prototype vCPU proxy spanning allocation and utilization assumptions, not a machine measurement.

vcore-hour.note: Prototype vCPU proxy spanning allocation and utilization assumptions, not a machine measurement.

node-hour.note: 16 vCPU-hours plus a host allocation allowance per node-hour.

gpu-hour.source: Challenge data dictionary, server_inventory.csv (300 W class); https://www.cloudcarbonfootprint.org/docs/methodology/
gpu-hour.note: Mid assumes 0.30 kW including allocated host overhead. Idle/load and hardware assumptions set the bounds.

gb-day.note: Converted from storage power proxy 0.5–3.75 W/TB over 24 hours, decimal GB.

gb.note: Broad proxy per GB where the source defines this unit as network egress.

runner-minute.note: Default runner assumption of four allocated vCPUs. Hardware varies.

capacity-day.note: Low-confidence reporting capacity proxy, 4–100 W average IT draw; validate service SKU.

token-small.note: Facility-energy proxy per weighted token. Inference uncertainty spans model sizes and throughput.

token-large.note: 0.24 Wh divided by assumed 300 weighted tokens in mid scenario. Google reports per prompt; token count and bounds are prototype assumptions.

message.note: Gemini median facility-energy anchor, applied as a proxy for other subscription messages.

video-minute.note: Analyst proxy for allocated datacenter IT and network processing; excludes endpoints and access networks.

growth.note: Annual blended demand and spend change; fixed CHF unit rates and grid intensity.

de.note: AIB 2024 DE residual direct CO2 724.56 g/kWh with sensitivity bounds; not a supplier contract.

ie.note: AIB 2024 IE residual direct CO2 365.61 g/kWh with sensitivity bounds.

eu.note: AIB 2024 unweighted mean residual factor across published mixes, used as a mixed-region proxy.

de.note: AIB 2025 calendar-year residual mix, CO2 spreadsheet. Low and high are scenario bounds.
2026 case proxy carrying forward the latest sourced 2025 residual factor. It is not a 2026 disclosure.

ie.note: AIB 2025 calendar-year residual mix, CO2 spreadsheet. Low and high are scenario bounds.
2026 case proxy carrying forward the latest sourced 2025 residual factor. It is not a 2026 disclosure.
